name: Golden-fronted Woodpecker
desc: Golden-fronted Woodpecker (Melanerpes aurifrons): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 139 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The golden-fronted woodpecker is a species of bird in subfamily Picinae of the woodpecker family Picidae. It is found in the southern United States (mostly Texas), Mexico and parts of Central America.
